info.title: cnpmcore HTTP API
info.description:
The complete HTTP API exposed by cnpmcore, including npm registry
compatibility endpoints and cnpmcore administration APIs.

bearerAuth.description: Npm/cnpmcore token sent in the Authorization header.

Fullname.name: fullname
Fullname.description: Package full name. Scoped names contain a literal slash, for example `@scope/pkg`. Send the slash literally; do not percent-encode it. For GET `/foo/sync`, the package-version route is selected with `versionSpec=sync`; the legacy synchronization endpoint only handles PUT `/foo/sync`.

FilePath.name: path
FilePath.description: File path inside the package, including literal slash separators, for example `lib/index.js`. Send the slashes literally; do not percent-encode them.

Json.description: JSON response. The exact shape depends on the operation.

Redirect.description: Redirect to the package file or resource.

PackageManifest.description: Npm package manifest. Additional npm manifest fields are preserved.
